{{Short description|Mathematical concept}}
In [[mathematics]], '''noncommutative residue''', defined independently by M. {{harvtxt|Wodzicki|1984}} and {{harvtxt|Guillemin|1985}}, is a certain trace on the algebra of [[pseudodifferential operator]]s on a [[compact space|compact]] [[differentiable manifold]] that is expressed via a local density. In the case of the [[circle]], the noncommutative residue had been studied earlier by M. {{harvtxt|Adler|1978}} and Y. {{harvtxt|Manin|1978}} in the context of one-dimensional [[integrable system]]s.
